notes: The sheet lists English wording and grammatical corrections for pages 402–425; page references jump over 406, 414, 418, and 424 as written. No date, heading, salutation, or signature appears.
At 402 the handwritten example has a hatted A with lower ab, followed by the literal comment that the ab is missing. The note concerns the copy, not absence of ab from this handwritten example.

At 407 the writer says formulaire is not English and describes formulary as a collection of formulae, somewhat like a list of magic spells; the writer calls formulary an excellent word to use. The parenthetical proposal is expressly qualified by however I feel and perhaps: not around but perhaps on and around.

At 407 l-15 the writer says relying is not used in this sense; its old French origin as a p.p of relier suggests a translation as binding. The phrase suggests a translation is retained as a qualification.

The missing-letter notes say that s in categories is missing on my copy (407 l3), that the last e of see is missing in copy (408 l3), and that e is lost off end of line in copy (411 l19). The last note does not specify any further corrected position for the e.
At 409 l-3 the quoted wording is dont feel that I have understood, with the apostrophe retained in the transcription. At 412 l.12 the instruction is to replace forgetting by to get.
The references In (75)e at 413 and In (84)e at 417 use baseline e, not a superscript. The page contains no mathematical assertion requiring a proof check; math_checks is empty.

Distinct dark points at 408, 416, and the right margin at 420 are preserved geometrically with their origin and punctuation function unassigned. The two pale circular right-margin traces are material observations only.

brief_feedback: The current ink, not the supplied notation table or neighbouring references, governs this reading. I read the whole once, each supplied half once, froze 39 unresolved loci before making any crop, and viewed each one of the 39 crops singly once. No OCR, recognition library, extraction, outside research, other page, other reader return, or compilation was used. The C paragraph divisions remain inside page-reference blocks; an outer table/TikZ wrapper anchors the previously omitted long rules beside the text. A limitation is that the lower-left endpoint remains very faint and crop38 does not securely bound its terminal point; this is reported rather than asserted.
